decisions.reason: As a core ergonomic office product with its own launch page, the desk system looks strategically aligned and still too early in its life to abandon while uncertainty remains.
A chair family is a standard furniture-category extension, and the dedicated presentation suggests enough commitment to keep the option open for further market learning.
The floor cushions are more experimental and peripheral to a furniture maker’s core business, but their likely low carrying cost supports keeping them on the market a bit longer.
The sofa appears to have had the weakest initial commitment since it was only mentioned rather than fully presented, making it the most plausible candidate to exit if early traction is unclear.
A high standing table fits well with workplace and collaboration trends in furniture, and a standalone page indicates the firm should continue observing demand before quitting.
The rug collection sits somewhat outside the firm’s core but can complement broader interior solutions, so management would likely preserve this option unless results soon disappoint clearly.
